name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
notes: Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration, read out of the base model's config.json: 40 layers, hidden 2048, 256 routed experts with top-8, vocab 248,320, native context 262,144. params_b and active_params_b are the vendor's own naming (35B total, A3B active) rather than a tensor count taken from a checkpoint; the served quant here is a community NVFP4 conversion, so a figure derived from its shards would describe the quantization rather than the model.
